insight: Founded by Andrew Ng in 2017; raised a $57M Series A in 2021 backed by Intel, Samsung and Insight Partners.
name: LandingAI
tagline: Build vision detectors and agents from a few labeled examples.
description: Build vision applications with a labelling-light workflow — point at examples, get a deployable detector. Recently extended into vision agents that reason over images and PDFs without bespoke training.
edge: Visual prompting lets you point at a few examples instead of labeling a full training set.
pros: Fast path to a deployable detector
cons: Less control than custom model training
